releases.displayName: Cattle Country: Bandits & Bounties Update - OUT NOW!

notes.title: Saddle Up, There's Trouble Brewing in Cattle Country

items.text: Bounty hunting, bandit camps, store robberies, new tools, expanded inventory, new outfits, and more are riding into Cattle Country.
Life on the frontier is about to get a little wilder.

A major new update is riding into Cattle Country, bringing new adventures, encounters and ways to make your mark on the frontier. Whether you're hunting wanted outlaws, stumbling across a bandit camp, crafting on the go, or simply looking for a mighty fine new hat, there'll be plenty more to discover.
There's a new way to earn your keep around these parts.

Keep an eye out for Wanted Posters at the Sheriff's building. Pick up a bounty and head out into the wilderness to track down the wanted bandit. Find your target, take them down and head back to Sheriff Tom to claim your reward.

But you'd best keep your wits about you out there. Bandit camps can now appear as you explore the overworld, giving you the chance to clean up the West and maybe even claim some plunder for your trouble.
And it seems trouble isn't staying outside of town…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/f0ae5446bf050de1842f3cb3ee827591a2d04ff2.png"]
Bandits have their eyes on the businesses of Cattle Country, and they're not exactly planning on paying.

Random robberies and shootouts can now break out at the General Store, Butcher, Carpenter and Bank. If you're around when trouble comes knocking, you might find yourself caught right in the middle of the action.
Together with bounty hunting and bandit camps, these encounters bring a little more danger and a lot more unpredictable outlaw action to everyday life in Cattle Country.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/64453ab51cfd3736b845bb5bed6eeccba036c655.png"]
A good frontiersperson is only as prepared as their pack, so we've got some new equipment to make life out West a little easier.
The new Toolbelt lets you craft wherever you are, without having to head back to your crafting table. Pick one up from the store, and you'll be ready to craft while you're out roaming the frontier.

And for those whose pack is always overflowing with crops, rocks and who-knows-what-else, the new Extra Large Bag expands your inventory to four rows, giving you even more room for everything you collect along the way.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/b829e23ece3748b4bfb20a56f6a7555c1217d907.png"]
Back at the homestead, there are three new pieces of equipment to put to work.
The Animal Trap provides another way to gather useful animal resources, while the Rock Tumbler can break down rocks into useful materials, with a chance of uncovering rare gems in the process.
Fashion-minded frontiersfolk can also get their hands on the new Tailoring Table, allowing you to make clothes and hats yourself and really look your sharpest.
Which is mighty handy, because...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/628860f6a56da265564716b804deaad80c0a2f4d.png"]
We're adding new outfits, hats and head accessories, giving you even more ways to make your character your own.
We've also heard from the redheads out there. Red hair is joining the character customisation options.
After all, nobody said catching bandits meant you couldn't look darn good doing it.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/8bd20997c70acc9b5a9877a94a223024e3956937.png"]
Had enough shootouts for one week? It might be time to hang up your irons and grab your fishing rod.
Head down to the docks on Tuesdays and Saturdays, and you'll be able to catch a boat to a special fishing spot where you can reel in fish from every season.
We've also made fishing a little more forgiving when you have an active fishing buff, making those bonuses feel more meaningful when you're trying to reel in a catch.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/03f866aba65e14febf0a3b999520d3df8f73b3b7.png"]
Not everything happening around these parts involves bandits and bullets.

Alongside all of the new content, the update includes a whole heap of smaller improvements and additions across Cattle Country. There's a ton of under-the-hood stuff too, but here are a few of our favourites:
We've expanded the pool of NPC dialogue to bring more variety to conversations.
Inventory counts now display beyond 9,999, giving you a more accurate view of just how much you've been hoarding.
And, perhaps most importantly, birds sitting in trees now sway with the branches in the wind.
Life in Cattle Country is getting bigger, busier and just a little more dangerous.
We'll see you out on the frontier, partner.
We've also been busy squashing a few bugs around the frontier. Here's a quick look at some of the fixes included in the Bandits & Bounties Update, with more details to come:
Fixed several controller issues when cooking and crafting, including incorrect ingredient costs, missing ingredient indicators and problems locking or unlocking chests for crafting.
Fixed an issue where your skin colour could display incorrectly when switching between creating a new game and loading an existing save.
Fixed a crash when playing in French during Dr. Andrew's ninth heart scene.
Fixed an issue where butchering too many animals at once could prevent animal resources from being collected the following day.
Fixed an issue where NPC cutscene invitation mail could be sent during winter when the associated scene wasn't available.
Fixed an issue where placing a Shed, Coop or Barn upgrade could incorrectly remove multiple upgrades from your inventory.
Plus plenty more fixes and improvements across Cattle Country.

topNew: Back at the homestead, there are three new pieces of equipment to put to work.

items.text: Howdy Pardners! Merry All Hallows' Eve! We've put together a spell and cooked up sumthin' real good for y'all. This is the second Cattle Country content update. This update allows ranchers to have children with their spouse along with introducing brand-new family interactions. That's not all, however! In celebration of Halloween, the update also introduces new Halloween-related activities to take place during the fall season such as pumpkin carving, tarot reading, a crypt maze and more!
As always, thanks to the Cattle Country community for your continuous feedback and suggestions. Y'all are square shooters in our books.
Full list of new content, fixes and quality of life improvements in the latest game update can be found below.
NEW CONTENT – Marriage & Kids: Have a baby. Both spouse and child have fun, unique behaviors.
Marrying Tom or Maggie automatically moves Sam or Grace into your home.

notes.title: Speak with your spouse or child to

items.text: "Pick Crops!"
NPC will pick crops until evening
"Help Me Out!"
NPCs will fill up to 20 items per day with random items
Empty equipment that is complete when they enter a map
"Relax"
Wander the farm and occasionally go fishing
When the player leaves the farm the spouse / child will continue to work on the farm while the player is away doing whatever action the player instructed them to do prior to leaving,
Your spouse makes breakfast every morning, dinner every night, and turns on fireplaces.,
They can fish, wander, and hang out around the farm.
NEW CONTENT – New Crypt Maze with a reward at the end (combat optional)
NEW CONTENT – Pumpkin Carving
NEW CONTENT – Tarot Reading
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – New decorations
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – New cosmetics
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Communal Cauldron (soup)
NEW CONTENT – Starting Farm Layouts: Islands, Hills, River, Mountains
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Sit Anywhere: Players can now sit on chairs and couches.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Smarter Crafting and Cooking: Craft and cook directly from nearby chests placed within 2 tiles from your workbench.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Building Upgrades: Coop, barn, and shed expansions increase size, capacity, and feature fresh new looks.

releases.displayName: Cattle Country: Beneath and Beyond Update

items.text: Howdy Pardners! We fixin' to serve you sumthin' real good. We've been really putting our backs to it and are finally ready to launch the first Cattle Country content update. This update will take exploring the Mine to whole new depths while also improving the life on the ranch.
Thanks to the Cattle Country community for your continuous feedback and suggestions. Y'all are square shooters in our books.
Full list of new content, fixes and quality of life improvements in the latest game update can be found below.
NEW CONTENT – Repeatable Town Project – Fire In The Hole. Causes a reset of mine. Unlocks after Jeb’s third heart cutscene.
NEW CONTENT – Drill added for faster digging. Unlocks at Mining Level 10. Player will receive a letter about it.
NEW CONTENT – Scavenger Anvil added. Breaks down items to reclaim some components. Unlocks at Mining Level 6.

NEW CONTENT – Players have a % chance to encounter Clickable Mine Objects in the mine with loot ranging from mine torches, ladders, platforms, elevators, dynamite to Ores, processed goods, crops, seeds, coins etc.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Mining helmet auto-equips in the mines and swaps back when leaving.
NEW CONTENT – Hay Dropper added. Auto-feeds hay for livestock. Unlocks at Farming Level 8.
NEW CONTENT – Scratch Post added. Place in a barn or coop to keep animals happy (simulates player petting the animals). Unlocks at Farming Level 9.
NEW CONTENT – Aquariums added to put your fish in. Small unlocked on Fishing Level 2. Medium unlocked on Fishing Level 5. Large unlocked on Fishing Level 8.
NEW CONTENT – Play a tune to summon your horse. Unlocks once a player has built a stable and obtained your own horse.
NEW CONTENT – Added walleye fish to lakes in spring/fall. It was previously uncatchable.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Added letters that inform the player of items they have already unlocked, from this update.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Town Hall shows previews of needed donation items.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Emily now sells seeds out of season. Player must unlock the greenhouse first.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Maggie sends you a letter if items block house upgrades.

notes.title: GENERAL FIXES AND QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS

items.text: CRASH FIX – During Pattie 1 if player finished dialogue while throwing plate on the table the game would require a restart.
CRASH FIX – The game would crash if you used the mine whistle while climbing a ladder.
CRASH FIX - Checking the map while Wild Will was inside a building would crash the game, e.g. Pattie 3.
BUG FIX / NEW CONTENT – Put egg or turkey egg into crock pot to make mayonnaise.
BUG FIX / NEW CONTENT – Add corn to the mill to make cornmeal.
BUG FIX / NEW CONTENT – Add beets to the mill to make sugar.
BUG FIX – Could not complete the boxcar race after year 1.
BUG FIX – Yams took 8 days instead of 11 days like they said they should, switched to 11 days.
BUG FIX – Jim 3 cutscene in saloon had duplicate animations / objects.
BUG FIX – Post office should have been open on Saturdays.
BUG FIX – Mayor Archibald now says the correct name of your animal at the end of the livestock fair, if you win.
BUG FIX - Sometimes the Secret Santa would mess up the people and not work.
BUG FIX – If you gave your Secret Santa a gift before the winter feast, you could not give them a gift during the festival.
BUG FIX – Player horse colour changing during cutscenes.
BUG FIX – Ho ho ho, if you quit Winter Feast early, Jim would stay in his Santa costume.
BUG FIX - Winter graphic overlays didn't delete when you removed a piece of equipment in the winter.
BUG FIX – Crafting buff did nothing, now gives you a 10% chance of making 2 items for the cost of 1.
BUG FIX - Fixed the Winter Feast donation box on controller.
BUG FIX – Fixed still wearing clothing while riding the horse naked.
BUG FIX – Added potassium nitrate to the mines. It was previously very difficult to get.
BUG FIX – Fixed the general store sale items discount transferring to the buy tab.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – You get a letter the day of the Winter Feast informing you of who your Secret Santa is.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Expanded the capacity of the level 3 and 4 water cans.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Empty water barrels sold at general store during the spring.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Mill take 1 in-game hour to make flour/sugar/cornmeal.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Added default recipe for grilled animal meat.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Shipping box and chest graphics show open frame when hovering over them with your mouse
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – Bank pays out your earned interest into your account on the 1st of every month.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT – All seeds available at the general store restock on Mondays after player has built a greenhouse.
Howdy pardners!
In case yall missed it, another patch of fixes and quality of life updates went live over the weekend.

notes.title: Full list of updates and fixes

items.text: Updated achievement requirements - Changed the way the Gold Achievement (6) checks to make sure players can achieve it: livestock made easier to win. Previously you required a 5-star "happy" farm animal, otherwise 1/3 chance. This has now been changed to 4-star plus equals guaranteed win
Updated moving kit - You can now use the moving kit on your house when not under construction
Updated hunting - Health of wild animals and damage of players bullets and arrows have been adjusted to make hunting easier
Fixed pickaxing - You could pickaxe the fencing of a moving building plot to get back a free version of the building you are moving
Fixed quest - Fixed the Fields ' Glory quest
Fixed tile selector - Gray tile selector could not be seen in the winter
Fixed drawing selector - Gray drawing selector could not be seen in the winter
Fixed soft lock issue - If you entered Tom's heart scene 9 while riding a horse, you would be soft locked in the train cart
Fixed crash - Random chance of the game crashing during a stickup
Fixed routines following marriage - Sometimes when you married someone they would stop doing their daily routines which was a big problem for store owners.
Fixed rodeo bug - Sometimes players would get stuck in the air at the rodeo after riding the bull
Fixed new game bug - If you were playing a save file and then exited to the main menu and started a new file, two things would happen:
Your spouse would not reset
Jeb's house state would not reset
Fixed bug - The scarecrow range bug
Fixed bug - Could not get rabbit poo
Fixed newborn animals - Newborn chicks and calves would appear in your house on Day 1 of their lives
Fixed quest requirements - Newborn calves did not count towards the Raise Four Cows quest
Fixed town hall donations - Four crop items were missing visually from the town hall. They would not show up after donating.
Townsfolk now have icons on the map screen to ease the tracking of NPCs
Players are no longer able to give non-town NPC gifts
Right click or press X on controller to change the name/colour of your horse
Train boxes no longer turn invisible if you steal from them
Added poo to hares
Howdy Pardeners!
A wee lil' patch update as we head into the weekend!
Fixed continuous flooring - Holding down Left Mouse Button or A on a controller resulted in flooring being put continuously on top of itself.
Fixed shipping box - If you pressed B to close the shipping box, it added one of what you had been hovering over to the box.
Sprinklers now fill up pet bowls.
Tips have been added on the pause menu in the villagers tab for where to go when a heart scene is ready.
Boy howdy, another one?!
The work hasn't slowed down in the workshop and here's another set of them fixes and updates for ye.

To our players on the other platforms, we appreciate the frustrations around PC patches going live while waiting on consoles to catch up but we want to reassure you that we are working as fast as we can to get all the platforms synced up and apologise that there are still issues on consoles. The reason consoles are dragging behind is the lengthier submissions processes compared to PC, varying from 2 days to 2 weeks, while Steam allows developers to publish patches whenever they are ready.

notes.title: Full list of fixes and updates

items.text: Fixed glitch - Slide stuck on the left side of the town map
Fixed furnace - If you put less than 5 sand in a furnace, on the "requires 5" ticker message it showed a picture of clay
Butcher resource glitch - If you took your animals to the butcher and then closed the game before picking them up, when you next visited the butcher to pick up your resources there wouldn't be any
Fixed inventory discard - Sometimes you wouldn't be able to delete inventory items. Nothing would happen when you clicked the trash
Fixed the 24 hour clock (for real) - The time would still show 24:00 at midnight instead of 0:00
Fixed resource rewards from butchering - Butchering calves and chicks for ridiculous amount of resources is no longer possible
Fixed animals restrictions in barns and coops - Players would be able to have more than 6 animals in their barn or coop if babies were born on the same day
Fixed chick growth - Baby chicks no longer exclusively turn into white chickens
Fixed calves growth - Baby calves no longer exclusively turn into white cows
Fixed localisation issue - Resource names when butchering an animal weren't translating
Fixed equipment pickups - If you had equipment on a carpet, there was a 50/50 chance you couldn't put anything in the equipment
Fixed villager pause menu - If you gave someone a present and you only had 1, the gift icon would not show up on the villagers pause menu
Hold down right mouse button, or X on the controller, to take/move more than 1 on menus
Worms won't spawn on tiled soil, making them untillable
Removed Jane's "Kill 10 bandits" quest if the player has enemies turned off
Stopped mushrooms from growing on trees with sappers
Howdy, Cowpokes!

A whole week of cozy life in the Wild West is already behind us. Hope yer tending them crops and feeding them chickens. Maybe there's even already some romance up in the air? We've been keeping our sleeves rolled up and hands dirty too and have another patch update to share with yous right now!

notes.title: FULL LIST OF FIXES AND UPDATES

items.text: Improved player walk and horse speed - Both the player character and their horse now traverse the wilderness a little bit quicker.
Fixed game crash when hoeing out of bounds - The game would crash if the player used the upgraded hoe to hoe outside of the bounds of the map
Fixed rodeo crash - Rodeo suffered from the same crash as the Hoedown event where the game crashed if you spoke to someone after the event.
Fixed inventory crash - The game would crash if players held shift while pressing to reorganize their chest or inventory.
Fixed menu closure issues - Menu would randomly stop closing using P or ESD.
Fixed building duplication bug - Buildings no longer duplicate randomly when attempting to move them around.
Fixed relationship advancement - It previously took 2 heart levels worth of gifts to get to level 2 heart after auto-gaining level 1 from introductions. This is no longer the case.

Fixed R key and key reconfiguration - The R key is no longer used for both rotating chairs/sofas and changing rows in your inventory at the bottom of the HUD. Use keys Q and E to change rows in your inventory.
Fixed Maggie quest dialogue and controller issue - Maggie 3 hearts scene used to say craft 10 items in dialogue and description instead of 50. The scene also didn't work on controllers.
Fixed item duplication - If you had an item on the mouse when you close any menu, the item amount would be doubled and put back in your inventory
Fixed wine rack - When removing items from wine rack, using mouse, you could get anywhere from 1-14 bottles back
Fixed gin icon - Gin showed the wrong icon on the distiller pop-up
Fixed inventory chest stacking issue - Sometimes items in your inventory chest would become unstackable, two of the same item with the same quality could not be combined
Fixed unlimited bull riding gifts - The player could get unlimited bull riding gifts.
Fixed bull achievement requirements - Ride the bull achievement was set to 60 seconds to obtain but the description says 30 seconds. The requirement has been changed to 30 seconds.
Fixed achievement bug - The mayor's gifts for donating were not working properly, causing players to be unable to complete the achievement.
Fixed tool upgrading - If you upgraded a tool, pickaxe for example, and had a lower quality pickaxe in your inventory, it would combine tools and override to the lower one
Fixed chocolate bar cooking cost - Chocolate bars had no cooking costs and could be made for free and sold for 220g.
Fixed glass making - Players couldn't make glass in the furnace (5 sand + 1 coal).
Fixed tree seeds - Tree seeds no longer result in the wrong tree type, for example apple tree seeds turning into lemon trees.
Fixed 24hr clock - Midnight is now shown as 0:00 instead of 24:00.
Added range overlay to scarecrows and sprinklers.
Gain a speed buff once a day from using the outhouse.
Number of birds per map have been reduced.
Store open hours added - Click on the store doors to see their opening hours (when closed).
Building tooltips added to the pause map
Sight line added for guns when using a controller
Howdy pardners!

Hope you are enjoying your cozy Wild West life so far! We been busy gathering your feedback, replicating bugs and figuring out them fixes for ya. And lo' and behold, we have the first post-launch patch live RIGHT NOW, addressing some issues flagged by the community.

notes.title: Full list of fixes in this patch

items.text: Fixed localisation bug - The game no longer stops player from progressing after reaching farming level 3 when playing with the Japanese language.
Fixed cutscene - Patients from scene 3 with Andrew no longer get trapped in the Dr's office after the scene is completed.
Fixed backspace on SteamDeck - Backspace now works on SteamDeck.
Fixed SFX - There is no longer a chance that the elevator SFX never stops playings.
Fixed unbreakable stumps - The game no longer shows the interaction hand icon that caused some tree stumps to be unbreakable.
Fixed moving building kit issues - Controller issues have now been fixed and buildings should no longer phantom duplicate randomly when moving them.
Fixed second rodeo ride - Game no longer softlocks after 50 seconds.
Fixed tree and mushroom growth - Trees and mushrooms now regrow normally after enough time passes.
If an issue you have reported is not on the list above, rest assured that we continue to log bugs posted on the Steam Community and on Discord and are working on fixing them as soon as we can!
This same patch update will be coming to Xbox this week and PS5 and Nintendo Switch in the next week or so.

releases.displayName: Small patch rolling out to Cattle Country beta!

items.text: Howdy folks!
We're rolling out some quick fixes for the demo now to make things a little easier! Check out the patch notes below:
Dog follows the player less
Buffer on petting pets, after petting, can't pet again for 10 seconds
Removed collision from cat/dog to stop them getting in the way
Fixed pets blocking bed
Fixed cat moonwalking
Blocked selling of tools
Added the tools to the Blacksmith in case they get lost
Fixed an issue where the demo was ending early after you do the hoedown

Fixed inputting the letter "P" closing the pet window: Thank you for all of your feedback on Cattle Country's systems and gameplay elements so far! Please keep your feedback coming either on here or in the Playtonic & Friends Discord, where we have a lovely little community forming around Cattle Country!
Howdy Folks,
Wow, we are absolutely blown away by the number of you who signed up for the Cattle Country Beta! 🐮
Our goal is to make Cattle Country a game that’s shaped by you – our amazing community. Your feedback will do just that!
We’ve had such an influx of sign-ups that, sadly, not everyone will get a spot in the beta this time around. There will be more opportunities to play Cattle Country down the trail. 🤠
The Beta dates will run from 14th of August and there will be a staggered start, those who have been selected, we will be reaching out shortly to confirm your participation.
Sign-ups are now CLOSED.
Playtonic x CastlePixel
Howdy folks!

Two days ago we opened up signups for the Cattle Country closed beta and we've been absolutely blown away by the response so far! We've seen over twice as many signups than we initially predicted. The Castle Pixel team and ourselves at Playtonic are incredibly chuffed to see so many folks who're keen to try the beta and help us shape Cattle Country into the best game it can be!
With this being said, we're going to keep signups open until Monday the 15th of July to ensure that when we can collate and act upon your feedback to the best of our ability.
Thank you so much to everyone who has expressed interest in Cattle Country so far. We can't wait for you to try the game!

Please consider wishlisting the game if you're reading this and haven't done so already, it's really beneficial to indie developers as it helps grow the presence of the game and helps us share more news with you directly!
